name: Unfamiliar
source:
The story follows Ophelia, a teenage girl whose family life is upended by strange events at home, leading her to question whether the people around her are truly who they seem.

[From [url=https://jpanou78.itch.io/unfamiliar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了奥菲莉亚（Ophelia），一个十几岁的女孩，她的家庭生活因家里发生的奇怪事件而被打乱，这让她开始质疑周围的人是否真的是他们看上去的那样。

[来自[url=https://jpanou78.itch.io/unfamiliar]Itch.io[/url]]
